contract: Typed definition record containing operator or object semantics.
Canonical JSON, excluding the content-hash field, determines the SHA-256 address.
Every composed definition names its dependencies by ID.
IDs, schema versions and profile versions distinguish definitions and semantics.
An instance references a definition and carries literal parameters and state.
A finite dependency graph admits a deterministic topological order.
The inherited implicit-field record declares its signed membership convention.
Exact signed-distance status is declared for the applicable field and metric.
A curve, parameter domain, regularity class and transport rule define a family.
A positive pulse count maps to a point, segment or regular polygon.
Powers of the radix give digit thresholds and addresses for declared nested shells.
The chart carries logarithmic radius, angle and an explicit singular-core flag.
Ports carry coordinate, orientation and optional sheet transport.
Coordinates, sheet, phase, orientation, branch and coupling policy are separate state.
Orientation follows the declared maps and transitions.
An admitted event chooses an output port from an explicit finite routing table.
A split names children; a merge records all parents and their addresses.
A topology-class change is committed through its declared transition rule.
A hinge contains pivot, state, selected map, guard and invariants.
A pivoted rotation defines position and differentiated velocity.
A Boolean state selects one of two maps or routes.
A graph connector carries incidence and its declared numerical contribution.
The stored order of composition is part of the hinge definition.
Fixed points, axes and preserved quantities are stated in the hinge contract.
A versioned 0–99 lexicon records spelling, segments, morphemes and hinges.
Each segment in the declared profile emits one pulse.
For 13–19, the unit root precedes the suffix tien in the spoken chart.
Non-multiple tens use the order unit, en, tens.
An explicit map permutes semantic components and inserts the connector.
A Boolean test compares pronunciation-profile pulses and binary Hamming weight.
The ten phases run from parse and normalization to transition and lineage.
Support is evaluated before compatibility and relation-guard solving.
Each executed step records definition ID, operator kind and typed output.
The provenance record identifies the source or formal construction of each mechanism.
Loading checks unique IDs, resolved references, verified hashes and an acyclic graph.
Schemas, tests, source hashes, file digests and reproducible examples accompany the corpus.
